# Shape of Data {.site-name .unlisted}

::: {.lede}
A course and blog on topological data analysis: the maths behind persistent homology, and how to use it on real data.
:::

[Start the course](course/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [Read the blog](blog/index.qmd)
